## What

Describe the change in a few sentences.

## Why

Explain the problem this solves, or link the issue: `Closes #`

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run size` passes, or the size change is explained below
- [ ] Light and dark screenshots are attached (visual changes only)
- [ ] No runtime dependency added, and no import leaves the package
- [ ] Any algorithm ported from another source has a line in `PROVENANCE.md`
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
